title.zh: Bloomberg: Over $170M in Unusual Hyperliquid Oil Perp Orders Raise Spoofing Susp
title.en: Bloomberg: Over $170M in Unusual Hyperliquid Oil Perp Orders Raise Spoofing Susp

current_state.zh: Solidus Labs flagged over $170 million in unusual Hyperliquid oil perpetual futures orders across two accounts between March 8 and 10, a pattern Bloomberg reported as resembling spoofing while leaving manipulative intent unproven.
